summary: Linn County, OR ground lookout on Monument Peak in Willamette NF; cabin from 1921, 14x14 house 1942, staffed into the 1950s; removed 1973, no source describes the site now.

facts.design: L-4 cab built 1942 atop the middle summit (Register); 14x14 standard lookout house on a concrete base (1946 survey)
facts.status_note: Removed in 1973 per the Register and Forest Lookouts; firelookout.com says destroyed that year. No source we read describes what remains at the site

access.note: No source we read says whether the site is open to the public

events.note: Alidade established on the peak (c.1914, Forest Lookouts)
Camp established on the peak (Register and firelookout.com)
Lookout house or cabin added on the peak
Mike Hobson employed at the lookout station for three months (October 1929 report)
Mike Hobson in charge of the lookout station (September 1930 report)
Linn County fire association moves the lookout station to a more advantageous position a short distance from the old one
Arville Downing stationed as lookout on Monument Peak
District warden report says the peak needs a new fire finder and lookout house
Linn County Fire Patrol association completes a new 14x14 standard lookout house on the summit (report of August 1942); Register gives the L-4 cab as built in 1942 atop the middle summit
Charles Graves, the lookout then on duty, to be first to occupy the new structure
Ed Cox and Henry Thompson on duty for the duration of the war
AWS post activated August 13, 1942 (Portland Filter Center listing)
Linn County FPA survey: 14x14 standard house on a concrete base, in need of paint, fire finder disk to be replaced
Mr. and Mrs. Albert Simons at the lookout for the rest of the summer
Simons on duty at the Monument Peak lookout station; a 1956 report says they have served as lookouts for many years
A new storage facility built at the lookout (Forest Lookouts)
Lookout removed (Register and Forest Lookouts); firelookout.com says destroyed in 1973
Registered May 11, 2011 as FFLOS US 978, OR 336; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register and Forest Lookouts say the cab was removed in 1973, while firelookout.com says it was destroyed that year. The year agrees across all three; we use 'removed' because two sources say it.

sources.title: Monument Peak Lookout Site, Former Fire Lookout Sites Register

notes_for_editor: Start date conflicts: Forest Lookouts shows an alidade about 1914; the Register and firelookout.com start with a camp in 1916; both are recorded and not resolved. Kind 'ground' kept: the sources describe a lookout house or cabin with an L-4 cab on the summit, not a tower. Access level unknown: no source says whether the site is open. No source we read describes what remains at the site. The 1964 storage facility and the 1946 concrete base are the only physical details and their current status is not described. Location distance: firelookout.com gives 8 miles WSW of Detroit and a 1942 newspaper says 10 miles east of Gates; not reconciled. No height in the brief and none found, so no height_m. Staffing as_of 1973 is inferred from removal; last documented staffing is 1956 (Simons). No photos with URLs found.
